The shared pressure-related condition does not establish recognition of the gold inclusion defect.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both entries identify the pressure limiter's use of a linear interpolation/secant formula as if p were affine, despite the Tammann pressure being a ratio of affine functions, yielding a limited state with p below the claimed threshold.
